::: typewriter
CROWN TELEVISION. SOUND DEPARTMENT. TAPE CASE NO. 2.
:::

::: handwriting
**Label on the lid of my tape case**

Word lock, eight letters. The word is on the leader of Tape Seven.

**Leader of Tape Seven**

Every reel starts with a strip of white leader tape, and I mark it with my pen. R. reads every label in the van, but he cannot read my short and long strokes. Radio school was good for something.

On 22 December I climbed the tower with Hubert. I saw what lives up there, and I put it on this leader in four words.

A small gap ends each letter. A wide gap ends each word.
:::

{{artifact}}

::: note
Copied at radio school and kept in the lid of the case, for the night when I forget a letter.
:::
